name: Hancock Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10300159 (194 days observed, edges closes)
note: Wooded sites along the Pemigewasset River, some of which are right on the water's edge.  Reservations website does not properly distinguish between tent-only and RV sites.  Call the campground to clarify.  --AWH

name: Lake Sherwood Recreation Area
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232009 (134 days observed, edges opens)

booking.note: Reservations on recreation.gov close 4 days before arrival and carry a 2-night minimum (rec.gov rule, not marked soft). Not a standing minimum: 34 of the standard sites are not reservable, tent-only Cales Knoll is first-come, and in spring and fall only the West Shore Loop is open and its sites are not reservable. 14 nights a month.

note: One of WV's best campgrounds with several campsites are right on the lake.  --AWH

name: Tracy Ridge Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232126 (138 days observed, edges closes)

booking.note: Reserve on recreation.gov; some sites are always first-come, and the 2026 rate table runs a first-come, first-served season from September 9 to December 16. Weekend reservations 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. 14 nights in any 30. Check-out noon; fees paid by 2 pm by envelope.

note: Allegheny NF ridge-top campground, a base for the Tracy Ridge trail system about 5 miles above the Allegheny Reservoir; concession-run (Allegheny Site Management). Reservable online in summer, with some first-come sites and a first-come fall season; no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water in loop E; the dump station is closed (2026). Back-in sites fit RVs ~25-60 ft. Not on the water. --Claude

name: Cobb Ridge Recreation Area
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233135 (284 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Developed USFS Mark Twain NF campground for the Chadwick motorized-trail area near Chadwick; 45 sites incl. ~25 electric (30/50A), paved pads; standard sites reservable online; open year-round (no horses). --Claude

name: Ada Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 249581 (139 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Laona RD) on 75-acre Ada Lake. Majority fit 30 ft+, some 45 ft+. Swim beach, boat landing. Open ~May 2-Oct 15. --Claude

name: Boulder Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233777 (112 days observed, edges opens)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona RD) on 362-acre Boulder Lake - the forest's largest campground. ~89 single sites plus group sites; back-in sites up to 45 ft; 23 sites with 50-amp electric. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Laurel Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255123 (134 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on Laurel Lake (Three Lakes-Eagle River Chain). Max length varies by site (25 ft: 4,5,8,9,10,12; up to 40 ft: site 2). Reservable online (sites 3-5,9-12). --Claude

name: Lost Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255122 (139 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on 86-acre Lost Lake (no motors). Single-family sites; accessible facilities, sandy swim beach. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Luna-White Deer Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255121 (139 days observed, edges closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on two non-motorized lakes. Single-family sites; max length varies (25 ft min, up to 40 ft). Half the sites front the lakes (lakeshore sites priced higher). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Morgan Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234169 (123 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Florence RD) on 45-acre Morgan Lake (electric motors only). 18 family sites plus 1 group site; max length varies (25 ft: 1,11,13,15; up to 40 ft). Accessible vault toilets, beach and boat ramp. Reservable online. --Claude
